youtube.baslik: How is the Dix-Hallpike test performed? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In the Dix-Hallpike maneuver, the head is turned 45 degrees toward the ear being tested, the patient is brought quickly to supine, and the head hangs about 20 degrees back. The eyes are watched for at least 30 seconds; the lower ear is the ear being tested.
